t.why: An EU member facing migration from the direction of Libya.
t.rel: A small island country in the middle of the Mediterranean and an EU member. Like Italy, it faces migration from the direction of Libya.
t.know: Its megalithic temples from around 3600 BC are older than the Egyptian pyramids.
t.etext: Online gaming, finance, tourism and ship registration drive the economy. Its growth rate is high for the EU.
